sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/wonder-of-the-seas/v2491/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] element per stateroom. Category legend built by matching each fill colour to Royal Caribbean stateroom categories, verified per-colour against cruisedeckplans.com stateroom-details pages and exact category counts.

notes.completeness: FULL grid: every stateroom on every guest deck (decks 3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,14,17,18). Decks 4,5,15,16 and public areas carry no staterooms in the source. Total 2886 matches deckmaps advertised count; cruisedeckplans category total is ~2892 (a few accessible/duplicate rows counted differently).
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 32 distinct fills map to 18 Royal Caribbean categories (several categories use more than one colour shade). See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Length axis and bow direction detected per deck from cabin numbering, confirmed by the aft AquaTheater suites; section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the hull length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam into two rows, labelled port/starboard assuming a standard viewed-from-above deck plan with the verified bow direction. Could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
